notes: After rounds 1-2 (best 0.95 at 12/4/30/0.3/0.9, then 0.93 at 12/5/32/0.3/0.8). Neighbours of those two: both are narrow (12 mm), short (30-32 mm), high TPU (0.8-0.9), shallow V (0.3).
